output_list.criticism: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition '&& balances[_to] + _amount > balances[_to]' can be exploited to overflow the balance of '_to' and set it to a target value.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition '_amount > 0 && balances[_to] + _amount > balances[_to]' can be exploited to overflow the balance of '_to' and set it to a target value.
